issue_text:
ifad/chronomodel#379 (by dimvic): Eager queries are not temporal
Bug, not regression.
Queries that join associations inline (`.jois`, `.left_outer_joins`, `.eager_load`) produce SQL that does not take `as_of_time` into account.

```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'bundler/inline'

gemfile(true) do
  source 'https://rubygems.org'

  # gem 'chrono_model', github: 'ifad/chronomodel', tag: 'v3.0.1'
  # gem 'chrono_model', github: 'ifad/chronomodel', tag: 'v4.0.0'
  gem 'chrono_model', github: 'ifad/chronomodel'

  gem 'pg'
  gem 'debug'
  gem 'rails'
end

require 'chrono_model'
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'logger'
require 'debug'

# Needs a database called `chronomodel_test`

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection(adapter: 'chronomodel', database: 'chronomodel_test')
ActiveRecord::Base.logger = Logger.new($stdout)

ActiveRecord::Schema.define do
  enable_extension :btree_gist

  create_table :activities, temporal: true, force: true do |t|
    t.string :name

    t.timestamps
  end

  create_table :activity_roadmaps, temporal: true, force: true do |t|
    t.belongs_to :activity
    t.string :name

    t.timestamps
  end
end

class Activity < ActiveRecord::Base
  include ChronoModel::TimeMachine

  has_many :activity_roadmaps, dependent: :destroy
end

class ActivityRoadmap < ActiveRecord::Base
  include ChronoModel::TimeMachine

  belongs_to :activity
end

activity = Activity.new(name: 'Activity')
activity.save!
activity.activity_roadmaps.new(name: 'Roadmap').save!

activity.update! name: 'Updated Activity'

$activity_roadmap_recorded_at = ActivityRoadmap.first.history.first.recorded_at

class BugTest < Minitest::Test
  # OK - no preload
  def test_historical_roadmap
    activity_roadmap = ActivityRoadmap.as_of($activity_roadmap_recorded_at).first
    activity = activity_roadmap.activity

    assert activity.name == 'Activity'
    # assert activity.as_of_time == activity_roadmap.as_of_time
  end

  # OK - lazy load
  def test_lazy_historical_roadmap
    activity_roadmap = ActivityRoadmap.as_of($activity_roadmap_recorded_at).includes(:activity).first
    activity = activity_roadmap.activity

    assert activity.name == 'Activity'
    # assert activity.as_of_time == activity_roadmap.as_of_time
  end

  # Not OK - eager load
  def test_eager_historical_roadmap
    activity_roadmap = ActivityRoadmap.as_of($activity_roadmap_recorded_at).eager_load(:activity).first
    activity = activity_roadmap.activity

    assert activity.name == 'Activity'
    # assert activity.as_of_time == activity_roadmap.as_of_time
  end
end
```

Generated query for the last case (association query skips as of):

```sql
SELECT "activity_roadmaps"."id"          AS t0_r0,
       "activity_roadmaps"."activity_id" AS t0_r1,
       "activity_roadmaps"."name"        AS t0_r2,
       "activity_roadmaps"."created_at"  AS t0_r3,
       "activity_roadmaps"."updated_at"  AS t0_r4,
       "activities"."id"                 AS t1_r0,
       "activities"."name"               AS t1_r1,
       "activities"."created_at"         AS t1_r2,
       "activities"."updated_at"         AS t1_r3
FROM (SELECT "history"."activity_roadmaps".*
      FROM "history"."activity_roadmaps"
      WHERE ('2025-09-14 21:46:52.420813'::timestamp <@ history.activity_roadmaps.validity)) "activity_roadmaps"
LEFT OUTER JOIN "activities" ON "activities"."id" = "activity_roadmaps"."activity_id"
```
